title: NBA Injury Watch — 30-Team Injury Monitor
description: NBA-only injury monitoring for all 30 teams: an injury board from the public ESPN structured injuries endpoint carrying source timestamps, status, reason, estimated return and review links (explicitly not official NBA confirmation), a live-style wire polling ESPN news, injuries, allow-listed Bluesky author feeds and game summaries every 60 seconds by default (configurable 30-300 seconds, with source publication delays and browser throttling named as additional latency), severity colour-coding, a WebAudio alert bell with a separate high-impact voice, and an official-NBA PDF adapter carrying a 229-row historical regression fixture across all 30 teams. tools/ holds the offline-verification layer, grown from 9 to 19 files since the previous read with poll, replay, smoke and reporter-verifier harnesses added. The Python suite was executed here with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest tools` and reports 26 passed. The JavaScript suites were executed here too and fail on data decay: verify_reporters_test.js reports 167 passed with 4 failed (a writer row whose prose says ACTIVE against a measured date that now reads dormant, plus transition-surfacing and key-shadowing cases), and smoke_test.js reports 237 passed with 1 failed (a stored citation quote that no longer appears verbatim upstream). The repository does not claim official NBA confirmation anywhere, and no live official report had been discovered at this head.
